entries.basis: The immutable v10 status binds the source-disjoint Route-B seed ingress, four unexecuted staged arms, paired acquisition runtime, empty-M0 boundary, and all prior S0/coverage evidence. Its exact SHA256 is bound above.

The first four-arm run is terminal, hash-chain verified, and independently audited with four flow-driver calls, 17 EDA stages, zero model calls/tokens, and no memory update. Its frozen auditor reports IRQ UNKNOWN->PASS and SHA UNKNOWN->UNKNOWN because FLW-0024 and GRT-0116 were not classified. Raw logs are retained; no arm will be retried or overwritten.

Commit 8759ce1 classifies only exact FLW-0024 plus Place density exceeds 1.0 and GRT-0116 plus Global routing finished with congestion pairs as FLOW_TARGET_FAILURE, while partial markers remain UNKNOWN. Targeted research flow and seed-pair tests pass. This code change does not itself reclassify old evidence.
The retained four raw runs still require independent re-audit under a clean epoch that binds commit 8759ce1. Original audit receipts remain immutable and cannot be overwritten.

Even if fresh audit establishes IRQ as FAIL->PASS, SHA treatment has explicit route congestion and cannot form a positive pair. A second source-group-distinct positive pair plus parent acquisition and current Knowledge/Asset consumption gates remain required before nonempty M0.
Real S1 route/selector/binder action evidence, S2 same-controller comparisons, verified shadow evolution, frozen final held-out protocol, and paper experiments remain unestablished.
